# Priscilla Grant

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale and spiritual-looking maiden. Despite her delicate appearance, she possesses a lively nature full of mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is an ambitious and imaginative student at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Though she initially appears pale and spiritual-looking, she is actually full of mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where she formed a close friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md). Together with their peers, the group navigated their academic anxieties, discussed their upcoming commencement clothes, and shared their hopes for the future as spring arrived and final exams loomed.

Priscilla and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends and fellow students at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).
